long_desc:
T-7000 Multi-Purpose Black Liquid Adhesive is an industrial-grade, high-elasticity bonding agent engineered specifically for acoustic speaker assembly, surround repair, dust cap installation, and precision electronic component bonding.

Featuring a built-in anti-clogging needle applicator cap, T-7000 allows pinpoint accuracy when applying adhesive along delicate speaker cone edges, basket lips, and voice coil joints without messy overflow.

Key Features & Acoustic Advantages:
• High Elasticity & Vibration Damping: Dries to a flexible, resilient rubberized bond that absorbs continuous cone excursions without cracking or brittleness.
• Deep Black Finish: Matches OEM speaker cones, foam/rubber surrounds, and dust caps for a seamless factory-original finish.
• Fast Tack Time: Initial surface positioning within 3–6 minutes, allowing technicians time to align the surround precisely before clamping.
• Multi-Substrate Adhesion: Superior bond strength on foam, rubber, treated paper cones, polypropylene, metal speaker frames (baskets), voice coil formers, and dust caps.
• Built-In Precision Needle Tip: Ensures micro-dose application with zero nozzle clogging between uses.

Technical Specifications:
• Appearance: Black viscous liquid
• Solid Content: 48% – 55%
• Viscosity: 4800 mPa.s
• Surface Dry Time: 3 – 6 minutes
• Complete Cure Time: 24 – 48 hours
• Temperature Range: -35°C to +90°C
• Net Volume: 50ml (1.68 fl oz) per tube
• Application: Speaker surround repair, dust cap gluing, reconing, diaphragm sealing, acoustic gasket bonding
